title: His Royal Majesty Eze Sir We Des O. Ogugua is a highly respected traditional ruler known for his integrity and significant contributions to society. Born in Eziudo Ezinihitte Mbaise, he has played a vital role in advocating for the creation of states and local governments in the South-East of Nigeria. Eze Ogugua is dedicated to uplifting the less privileged through scholarships, school construction, and community development projects. He is a member of various organizations and has received numerous awards for his contributions to Nigerian society. Additionally, he has a background in sales management and has authored a book on the Nigeria Police Force. Eze Ogugua is happily married with nine children.
